FAQ.title: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.subtitle: Everything you need to know about getting funded and managing your account.
FAQ.a1: A Proprietary Trading Firm (Prop Firm) provides capital to traders who can prove their skills. You trade their money, and keep up to 90% of the profits.
FAQ.a2: Most firms require you to pass an evaluation (Challenge). Once you hit the profit target without violating drawdown rules, you get a funded account.
FAQ.a3: Yes! We partner directly with top firms to bring you exclusive coupon codes. All codes are verified daily.
FAQ.q4: Which firm is best for me?
FAQ.a4: Use our filters! If you trade Futures, look at Apex or Topstep. For Forex, FTMO and Blueberry are industry leaders.
